newsitem.title: USA: Bernard Chaus sees Q2 loss, flat with yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Bernard Chaus sees Q2 loss, flat with yr-ago.

text.p: Bernard Chaus Inc said it expects its fiscal 1997 second quarter to be no better than last year's second quarter, due to weaker than expected holiday bookings.
The company reported a loss of $3.9 million or $0.17 per share on $49 million in revenues for last year's second quarter. Earlier today, it reported a first quarter profit of $0.01 per share.
Bernard Chaus said it expects stronger initial orders for spring coupled with tight inventory management to improve operating performance for the second half of the fiscal year.
